intro.text: Dalinar Kholin's first sword trainer, a young swordsman from a few towns over.

items.text: The Kholins were not yet powerful, so Dalinar's father had to settle for Harth, who was young and not a recognised swordmaster. Dalinar thought him reasonably skilled for his standing.

Dalinar told Kadash how Harth insisted he tie his takama a certain way, as Harth's masters always had. Dalinar traced the rule to an old ardent in Kholinar who tied it that way only because he was short, and used the tale to argue that following tradition blindly doesn't make it worthy.
